nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $E_n$ is the real Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ with its standard inner product and Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Model space for convex bodies

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the real vector space of continuous invariant valuations on the convex bodies of $\mathbb{R}^n$ (continuous, additive, and invariant under linear isometries and translations) is finite-dimensional of dimension $n + 1$.
nodes.title: Hadwiger's theorem

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued function $f$ on the convex bodies (nonempty compact convex subsets) of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is a continuous invariant valuation if: $f$ is continuous for the Hausdorff metric; $f(A) + f(B) = f(C) + f(D)$ for all convex bodies $A, B, C, D$ with $A = C \cup D$ and $B = C \cap D$; $f(e(A)) = f(A)$ for every convex body $A$ and every linear isometry $e$ of…
nodes.title: Continuous invariant valuation

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the continuous invariant valuations on the convex bodies of $\mathbb{R}^n$ form a real linear subspace of the vector space of all functions from the convex bodies of $\mathbb{R}^n$ to $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: The space of continuous invariant valuations

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
